name: TempCompass
intro: TempCompass是一个旨在全面评估视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）时间感知能力的基准测试。现有基准未能区分不同的时间维度，且任务形式单一。TempCompass通过引入多样化的时间维度和任务形式，并采用构建冲突视频和LLM生成指令的策略来收集高质量数据。该基准揭示了当前Video LLMs在时间感知能力上的不足。
org: Tsinghua University, Peking University, Tencent AI Lab, The Hong Kong University of Science and Tech
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 冲突视频, 人工质量验证, 混合自动评分
scale: 410个视频，500条元信息，7540条任务指令
intro_en: TempCompass is a benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the temporal awareness of Video LLMs. Existing benchmarks fail to differentiate between various temporal dimensions and have limited task formats. TempCompass addresses this by introducing diverse temporal dimensions and task types, and by using strategies such as constructing conflicting videos and generating instructions with LLMs to collect high-quality data. This benchmark reveals the current shortcomings of Video LLMs in temporal understanding.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TempCompass arXiv:2403.00476 Sections 3.1-3.4 and official llyx97/TempCompass repository. TempCompass defines five temporal aspects—Action, Speed, Direction, Attribute Change, and Event Order—with ten fine-grained sub-aspects and nine static-content categories. Raw videos are collected from Shutterstock, balanced across content categories, and checked not to occur in WebVid. To prevent language-prior and single-frame shortcuts, the authors construct conflicting pairs or triplets that preserve static content but change a temporal property through reversal, spatial concatenation, or temporal concatenation. Humans annotate 500 semi-structured subject-plus-temporal meta-information records over 410 videos. ChatGPT gpt-3.5-turbo first generates multiple-choice questions; humans correct them, after which ChatGPT derives Yes/No QA, Caption Matching, and Caption Generation instructions that are again human-corrected. At least 3, 2, 3, and 4 instructions per meta-information item yield 7,540 total instructions. Quality verification gives 200 sampled instructions to three humans. Evaluation first uses task-specific rules to parse explicit options for the first three formats and sends unmatched responses to ChatGPT. Caption Generation is judged only by asking ChatGPT to answer the corresponding multiple-choice question from the generated caption, including a None option. Accuracy is reported by task and temporal aspect.
